description: The label of an image, table or other file of a project, which a test uses to name the file as `res:` and the label's `id` instead of by its path. It sits next to the file, named after it with `.jevmeta` added, such as `login.png.jevmeta`: move or rename the two together. JEVision writes it itself.

$schema.description: Address of this schema, so that editors check the file and suggest its keys.

format.description: Version of the layout of the file. JEVision doesn't open a file in a format newer than it knows.

hash.description: `sha256:` and the SHA-256 of the file's content in 64 lowercase hex digits. With `size`, it finds the file again when it was moved without its `.jevmeta`.

id.description: The label, 16 lowercase hex digits: a test names the file as `res:` and the label.

kind.description: What the file is: an `image`, a `table` (a CSV or TSV file) or another `file`.

minVersion.description: The oldest JEVision that can open the file, such as 1.4.0. An older one asks to be updated instead of opening it.

name.description: The name the file had when it got the label, without its folder; shown when the file can't be found.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.

title: JEVision resource label
